ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Fever Wood
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
FEVERWOOD_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 — RimMandrake tier standalone build of the Fever Wood biome (Phase A row 22 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md; parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1). A hot, still, tree-canopied swamp: great solid trunks have rooted the backswamp still and tamed the flowing waters into shallow surface pools with deep mud beneath, laced with living-wood byways above the black, unrippled mirror pools below.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it. The three biome-level hazard modExtensions this def carries (the trunk, the mirror pools, the ground-refusal marsh) are defined in the shared mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards library (loadAfter, hard dependency) — this mod re-points them at RM_FeverWood; it does not re-author them.
⛔ Star Wars canon fauna and flora do NOT ship here — Q11a (owner ruling, 2026-09-22): a genuinely canon name is IP and must route through the Utinni campaign patch layer, never the franchise-free RimMandrake tier. Ten wildAnimals rows and three wildPlants rows that carry canon or RSW_ names ride src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Patches/WildAnimals_FeverWood.xml instead; this def ships only vanilla + one non-Star-Wars donor row (VFEI2_Megathrips) + three non-Star-Wars donor plants (AB_KeeningCordax, AB_Iashiphus, AB_Gomphoeria) + this mod's own RM_GiantLeaf.
Live proof (step 5, a scratch-world quicktest with all five expansions) is Desktop-only and OWED — see the item's own verify record.
